summary.text: Lilly Fuchs, listed by Ballotpedia as Elizabeth Fuchs and also known as Lilly, is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 80, an office she has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as public policy advocate.

paragraphs.text: Lilly Fuchs earned a graduate degree from the University of Missouri, St. Louis.

Ballotpedia says her career experience includes serving as manager of public policy and lobbyist for PROMO, working as a field advisor for the Master of Social Policy program and SED field faculty at the Brown School, teaching social policy analysis and evaluation, and acting as a policy consultant and community healer with the Metro Trans Umbrella Group.
Fuchs assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Peter Merideth, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Emerging Issues Committee and the Legislative Review Committee.
